answer: The vault admits a newcomer only after sponsors with no shared funding each lock 80 copper behind its key. When an auditor signs ivory tracing the newcomer's funds to an operator who already runs k-1 agents, the vault requires k sponsors, and none of them may already back a sibling. Copper behind any agent later proven to be a clone is forfeited. An honest newcomer needs one sponsor. An operator's 40 agents need 820 distinct strangers, so the operator must bribe away the risk on 65,600 copper.
